questions.q: A sector of a circle of radius \( r = 8 \text{ cm} \) has central angle \( \theta = 0.9 \text{ rad} \). What is the area of the sector?
questions.answer:
**Mark Scheme (CAIE / Edexcel Grading Steps):**
- **Step 1 (Method & Formulation):** Identify the required geometric/algebraic relationship from the diagram and substitute the given values. **[M1]**
- **Step 2 (Derivation & Calculation):** Sector area formula: \( A = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(8)^2(0.9) = 28.8 \text{ cm}^2 \). **[M1]**
- **Step 3 (Final Accuracy):** Verified exact result: \( 28.8 \text{ cm}^2 \). **[A1]**

Find all solutions of \( 2\cos^2 x + 3\sin x - 3 = 0 \) in the interval \( 0 \le x \le 2\pi \).
questions.answer: Solving quadratic trig equation \( 2\cos^2 x + 3\sin x - 3 = 0 \) yields solutions \( x = \frac{\pi}{6}, \; \frac{5\pi}{6}, \; \frac{\pi}{2} \). [M1][A1]
